rows.label: tlk45300143_03_msg0002
rows.name:
You always seem to use the same
Blades, don't you?

rows.label: tlk45300143_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Your Merc Group has grown enough to
handle plenty of Blades now.

rows.label: tlk45300143_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Well then, I'd urge you to try taking
all sorts of different Blades along
with you on your adventures.

rows.label: tlk45300143_03_msg0005
rows.name: That way, you'll grow as a Driver too.
